purpose: Teach: 容積/相乗/喝采/セレクション/省エネルギー/真っ最中/ダントツ/授賞

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、倉庫容積を綿密に計算された
lines.en: When Dad was founding the company, he calculated every detail of the warehouse capacity with precision.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. Reverent but not sentimental. Pauses between clauses as if drawing from memory. Soft, assured voice of someone recalling greatness with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の力に相乗効果を生み出された
lines.en: Yes. Dad had a gift for bringing out the best in his people—creating something greater together.
lines.style: Affirming, steady. A son honoring what he witnessed. Not announcing—acknowledging. Slight warmth on 'together,' as if feeling it in his chest still.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界の喝采を浴びる商品を世に出された
lines.en: Dad brought products to market that won acclaim across the entire industry.
lines.style: Tone softens with time-distance. Almost as though seeing it happen again. Slow, deliberate. A note of wonder underneath the respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは人材のセレクションに時間をかけられた
lines.en: Yes. He gave enormous attention to finding and choosing the right people for every role.
lines.style: Thoughtful, introspective. Speaking from observation—not repeating words, but understanding them now. Measured cadence. A man turning something over in his mind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、戦後の省エネルギー社会を予見されてた
lines.en: Dad understood what was coming—he saw the energy-conscious world of the postwar future before anyone else did.
lines.style: Voice carries both admiration and a trace of melancholy. As if marveling at foresight now proven right. Slower tempo. Respect layered with something like longing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは多忙真っ最中でも社員に挨拶された
lines.en: Yes. Even at his busiest, he never forgot to greet people. He was present for his staff.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Speaking from lived example. Warm but controlled—the voice of someone moved by a small, profound habit. Slight emphasis on the contrast between 'busy' and 'greeting.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界ダントツの実績を残された
lines.en: Dad left behind a record in the industry that no one has matched since.
lines.style: Voice reaches its highest emotional note. Awe held in check. Slow, weighty. Each phrase given its full moment. The voice of someone who has inherited a standard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが業界の授賞を多数受けられた
lines.en: Yes. The awards, the recognition—the industry honored him many times over for what he built and who he was.
lines.style: Closing with quiet finality. Tone deepens, becomes almost still. Not triumphant—something wiser. The voice of a son who carries the weight of that legacy and understands it fully now.
